before: An accepted or rejected change in a text box stayed in the review items, on the deciding editor and on a collaborating peer. Typing beside a text box listed its changes twice.
after: A decided change in a text box leaves the review items on every participant, and each change is listed once.
reason: The change is in the local review-queue cache, which each participant derives from its own document tree. It sends no operations, writes no shared state, and changes no serialization. Peers already received the same tree; only the derived list was stale.
